text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway――
Eeeeeek, i-it's too spicyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm. The calculations suggested that adding irritants would induce sweating and boost metabolism far better than standard sports drinks, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's a problem with consuming the necessary and sufficient dosage!
Ahaha~~, marvelous, Dantsu-kun!
Thanks to this, my research will advance another step!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew~ My tongue stings, but
I'm so glad I could help out~~.
Then, on another day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was so much fun~
Hey, can I come hang out in your room again?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Of course... you are welcome...
"Everyone" in my room... also said... they had fun...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Everyone in the room...? 
B-But yesterday it was just the two of us, Cafe-chan and me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh.
N-Next time I'll bring even more souvenir snacks...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I seriously recommend it! It's about delinquents, but
it's so touching and crazy hype!
I got the whole disc collection, you know!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—So yeah, meet in my room tonight.
Don't expect any sleep, so brace yourself, got it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Pokke-chan, you really oughta
get some proper sleep at night…… too――
choice_data_list: It must be tough being dragged around all the time.
It must be tough being dragged around all the time.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't quite say I get dragged around, but...
everyone at Tracen Academy really is
so full of personality.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I don't really have much of an identity myself, so I can't help feeling a little envious.
choice_data_list: Maybe being so easy to invite out is your special charm.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I don't really have much of an identity myself, so I can't help feeling a little envious.
choice_data_list: Maybe being so easy to invite out is your special charm.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, that's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's such a wonderful friend,
I just want to do whatever I can to help.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeey. Dantsu? Where are you~?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Oh, sounds like they're calling for me! I'll be on my way. Thank you so much for caring!

...I grew worried about what lay ahead for her,
but holding my tongue, I decided it wasn't my place to pry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
My "approachability"?
I see, thinking about it that way is also...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, Dantsu~! Let's totally go buy some midnight
snacks right now after all!
Hurry, hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, Pokke-chan!
I'm coming right now!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, maybe getting invited to fun things like this is thanks to having 'individuality'?
—Thank you so much for teaching me that!

I watched her happily dash off into the distance,
my heart warmed by the sight.
